bannerLead: Decades of social work, child welfare, and community service — in service of every young person who walks through our door.

staff.name: Lambert Adjibogoun
staff.bio: Years in Oregon Child Welfare and social services; founder of a 'second-chance' housing company and reviver of Metro's Home Share program. Holds an Executive MPA (PSU Hatfield), a Master's in Social Sciences, and bachelor's degrees in Philosophy, Communication & HR. Multilingual (Spanish, French).

staff.name: Kim Hartnagel
staff.bio: A career in social services with a B.S.W. from Wichita State University, and experience across the Family Support Center, Wichita Children's Home, and Child Protective Services in Kansas, Oregon, and Washington — centered on youth empowerment through supportive relationships.

board.name: Trevor Emmett

board.name: Wanda Brown
board.bio: Retired from Kansas DHS (Child Support, Foster Care, Adoptions); a life of church and community service.

board.name: Jessica Witte

board.name: Pamela Williams
board.bio: 25-year social-work career, Air Force veteran and Gold Star Mother, with degrees in Human Development and Peacebuilding.
